requests.prompt:
Vertical 2:3 card illustration in chunky, characterful stylized 3D-rendered dark fantasy style: Backstab Weasel, a wiry lime-green goblin assassin (#3ee06a skin) crouched low and coiled, ready to pounce. Camera is over-the-shoulder from behind him, low angle, so we see the back of his purple hood and one big pointed ear with an orange inner ear and a small gold earring. His body is turned three-quarters to the left, and his head turns further left in profile, glaring up past the viewer's eye line toward an enemy horde. His mouth is closed in a tight, narrow smirk with the tip of his tongue poking out the corner in concentration. Yellow-orange eyes narrow and mischievous.

He wears a torn, ragged purple hood and cloak with frayed edges and a faint orange-gold crowned-skull emblem on the back, rusty brown riveted leather straps, buckled belts, small pouches, stitched wrist guards and chunky iron-capped boots. In his right hand he grips a rusty, jagged dagger made of scavenged iron with bone-wrapped handle; glowing toxic green poison (#3ee06a) drips in thick strands from the blade, splashing in bright droplets on the ground.

Setting: he hides in the deep shadow beside a crooked wooden swamp-camp shack with a dim lantern, half swallowed by darkness. Beyond, a blurred moonlit swamp forest with twisted mossy trees, drifting fireflies, and a distant shadowy crowd of enemy silhouettes. Foreground: mossy rocks, roots, mud, floating dust and sparks, softly out of focus.

Lighting: cold blue moonlight, strong purple (#b45cff) rim light on hood and shoulders, green glow from the poison and small green crystals. Rich saturated color, painterly depth of field, highly detailed rusty metal and worn leather textures. Keep head, hands and dagger fully in frame. No text, logos, frames or borders.
